title: Gland Pharma block deal: Fosun Pharma divests 99 lakh shares worth Rs 2,800 crore
summary: Fosun Pharma sold a 6% stake in Gland Pharma for ₹2,800 crore via a block deal, reducing its holding to 45.77%. Major buyers included Kotak, Axis, and ICICI Prudential Mutual Funds, while Gland Pharma shares closed higher at ₹2,932.40.

title: RBI turns to 30-day VRRR to absorb excess liquidity
summary: The Reserve Bank of India is conducting auctions to absorb excess funds.  This liquidity stems from special dollar mobilization programs and forex inflows.  The central bank aims to manage surplus funds and control inflation pressures.  Analysts expect liquidity to potentially reach fifteen lakh crore rupees soon.  RBI also sold government papers to manage market liquidity effectively.

title: NSE IPO: Explained | What is an 'observation letter' issued by Sebi as regulator okays  ₹30,000 cr much-awaited issue
summary: Sebi issued final observations for the NSE's IPO on September 4, allowing the exchange to proceed with its long-awaited public offering. The IPO will consist of a 149-million-equity-share offer, with market estimates valuing it at around  ₹30,000 crore.

title: Lululemon shares dive on risks of prolonged overhaul under new CEO
summary: Lululemon shares plunged about 20% after the athleisure company cut its full-year forecast for the second time. Investors are weighing a potentially lengthy turnaround under incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill as the company struggles with weaker sales, shrinking margins, promotions and rising competition from brands including Alo Yoga and Skims.

title: Maharashtra pitches for Belgium investments
summary: Maharashtra's Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis invited Belgian companies to explore investment opportunities within the state, positioning the state as an essential hub for engaging with global markets. With the India-EU free trade agreement poised to enhance trade relations significantly, Belgium's Prime Minister Bart De Wever echoed the sentiment.

title: Pulse of the Street: US bond yields, interest rate jitters drag Indian equities lower this week
summary: Indian equities fell about 1% this week as higher US Treasury yields, elevated crude prices and foreign selling weighed on sentiment. Friday’s recovery offered little relief, with valuations, IPO supply and shifting rate expectations keeping investors cautious for the week ahead.
